name: limerick-cobol
description: Static-site checks for the Limerick COBOL tutorial.

scripts.check:search-index: tsx scripts/build-search-index.ts && biome format --write search-index.json && git diff --exit-code search-index.json
scripts.check:examples: tsx scripts/build-examples.ts && biome format --write examples && git diff --exit-code examples/
scripts.check:lesson-jsonld: tsx scripts/generate-lesson-jsonld.ts && biome format --write course && git diff --exit-code course/lesson-meta.json "course/**/*.html"
scripts.check:lesson-index: tsx scripts/build-lesson-index.ts && biome format --write course/index.html && git diff --exit-code course/index.html
scripts.check:reading-time: tsx scripts/add-reading-time.ts && biome format --write course && git diff --exit-code "course/**/*.html"
scripts.check:prev-next-links: tsx scripts/add-prev-next-links.ts && biome format --write course && git diff --exit-code "course/**/*.html"
scripts.check:exercise-prev-next-links: tsx scripts/add-exercise-prev-next-links.ts && biome format --write exercises && git diff --exit-code "exercises/**/*.html"
scripts.check:exercise-jsonld: tsx scripts/generate-exercise-jsonld.ts && biome format --write exercises && git diff --exit-code "exercises/**/*.html"
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:examples && pnpm run check:example-orphans && pnpm run check:search-index && pnpm run validate && pnpm run check:assets && pnpm run check:img-dims && pnpm run links && pnpm run a11y
